title: HyperSkill: Training-Free Omnimodal GRPO via Hypergraph-Indexed Skill-Library Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.15178v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning sharpens LLM reasoning, but parameter updates are expensive, forgetful, and opaque; training-free libraries swap gradients for a textual store but still use trajectory-level, correlation-based admission and flat structure. To address both, we propose HyperSkill, a Training-Free Omnimodal GRPO framework that keeps the backbone frozen and replaces gradient updates with auditable edits to a Hypergraph-Indexed Skill-Library, where skills are advantage-bearing nodes and compositions are hyperedges. It has three components: training-time distillation admits counterfactually checked skills and learns a protocol skill from failures; gated hypergraph retrieval injects advantage-ranked skills where a per-dataset gate admits them; and an execution protocol makes the frozen backbone commit to an answer. translated_title: HyperSkill：基于超图索引技能库演化的免训练全模态GRPO
translated_abstract: 强化学习能够提升大语言模型的推理能力，但参数更新代价高昂、易发生遗忘且过程不透明；免训练技能库虽以文本存储取代梯度更新，但仍采用基于轨迹层面相关性的准入机制和扁平化结构。为同时解决这两个问题，我们提出HyperSkill——一个免训练的全模态GRPO框架，它保持主干模型冻结，用对超图索引技能库的可审计编辑替代梯度更新，其中技能是携带优势信息的节点，技能组合则是超边。该框架包含三个组件：训练时蒸馏通过反事实检验接纳技能，并从失败中学习协议技能；门控超图检索在按数据集门控允许的位置注入按优势排序的技能；执行协议使冻结的主干模型给出最终答案。在11个文本、视觉-语言和全模态基准测试中，HyperSkill在每个数据集上都取得最佳或持平的成绩，并超越了最强基线。
tldr: HyperSkill是一个免训练的全模态GRPO框架，通过保持主干冻结、以超图索引技能库的可审计编辑替代梯度更新，在11个文本、视觉语言与全模态基准上均取得最佳或持平性能。
en_tdlr: HyperSkill is a training-free omnimodal GRPO framework that keeps the backbone frozen and replaces gradient updates with auditable edits to a hypergraph-indexed skill library, achieving best or tied performance across 11 text, vision-language, and omnimodal benchmarks.
